vmbus_recvpacket(dev->channel, recv_buffer, PAGE_SIZE, &recvlen, &requestid);

The return value is IGNORED. If packetlen > PAGE_SIZE, it returns -ENOBUFS and `buffer_actual_len = packetlen` (set before the check!). So recvlen could be > PAGE_SIZE with nothing copied into recv_buffer (well, recv_buffer was memset to 0). Wait — memset to zero first, then receive.
